description: Replays the 'persist-match-history' page: rows match the source, a poison record lands on the dead-letter topic with the error, and match_history holds 48 rows.

tests.description: Connect wrote every event to Postgres and dead-lettered the poison record

runShell.command: for i in $(seq 1 30); do lag=$(docker compose exec -T rpk rpk group describe connect-history </dev/null 2>/dev/null | awk '/^TOTAL-LAG/ {print $2}'); [ "$lag" = 0 ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo lag=$lag
docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U game -d game -c "SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) FROM player_events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"
docker compose exec -T rpk rpk topic consume game.player-events.dlq -o start -n 1
docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U game -d game -tA -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_history"
